verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API doc index entry for "List deleted applications". That implies application records can be deleted and the deletions tracked via the API, but there is no documentation of how users control deletion or set retention. Missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies, documented candidate/data deletion controls (e.g., GDPR erasure workflows), retention settings for AI transcripts/summaries, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
